scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.local:setup: npm run supabase:start && npm run local:reset
scripts.local:reset: supabase db reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
scripts.qa: npm run test && npm run build
